liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (6 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer ranks this Dark Star as probably their favorite of the 1973-74 period; Corrects an earlier reviewer: the text file calls this the third longest known Dark Star, at 43:28 [3][13][14][15][18][21][22]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer calls it the longest Sunshine ever and the best ever; Notes say it runs 15:38, the longest ever Here Comes Sunshine [3][16]
- **Loser** (1 review): Jerry's guitar distortion is noticeably bad during this song [20]

## Setlist highlights

- **I Know You Rider**: cut on the recording [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-12-06.166462.aud.cubbedge.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 186 min [1]
- **gd1973-12-06.147505.sbd.pc.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 204 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd73-12-06.sbd.kaplan-fink-hamilton.4452.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 184 min; rated 4.45/5 by 58 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience patches are not too bad; the set spans several discs; Sound rated excellent for 1973, though Jerry's distortion is rough during Loser [16][20]
- **gd73-12-06.sbd-part.nayfield.clevenger.fix-195.6703.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 88 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [7]

## Around the show

- Crowd is audible in the background and Donna is absent from the band, with little loss [21]
- After Deal, Phil asks if anyone has seen the comet yet [1]
- Donna Jean Godchaux is absent, out on maternity leave [1]
- Third longest Dark Star, but reviewer prefers the 2/15/73 version [16]
- Reviewer would have chosen this show over 12/19 as Dick's first release, finding that show's Other One too dissonant and short [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-12-06.166462.aud.cubbedge.flac16**: taped by Dave Cubbedge; source: Recorded by Dave Cubbedge on a Sony portable stereo recorder with a stereo mic. [1]. Also: Original 120-minute cassettes are lost; this first-generation copy was made in the 1980s onto 90-minute cassettes, adding tape flips [1]
- **gd1973-12-06.147505.sbd.pc.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Master Reel > Dat [2]. Also: Pitch-corrected version of shnid 132361, with input from Rob Bertrando and Joe B. Jones [2]
- **gd73-12-06.sbd.kaplan-fink-hamilton.4452.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard with Audience Patches [5]
- **gd73-12-06.sbd-part.nayfield.clevenger.fix-195.6703.shnf**: source: S:MR>Cass>SonicSolutions>DAT>ZA2>CD [7]. Also: Partial soundboard from Nayfield and Clevenger, fixed and retracked to fit on one 90-minute CDR [7]
